title: statusline r7 UX: human-form cause+recovery obligation has no architectural home
description: Round 7. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Owner: SO session. Defect: the human-form renderer is placed in neither pure core nor effectful shell; the derivation's degraded output is a bare boolean without the absent-vs-unusable distinction a differentiated next step needs; the snapshot does not materialize the cause; recovery text alone among deferred content has no authoring home; and tracker-absent is contractually a NORMAL offline mode — demanding a recovery action for it risks vacuous instruction. Citations verified: contract:163, :188, :199, :200, :203, :284. Proposed: resolved-candidate (degraded becomes a kind — absent or unusable — output by the derivation; per-kind next-step text ships as versioned data authored at 1c, the absent kind's text stating the normal offline mode; human-form rendering placed in the effectful shell).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: degradation is a kind, not a bare flag — the derivation outputs which corroboration condition holds (absent; unusable); per-kind next-step text ships as versioned data authored at 1c, with the tracker-absent kind contracted as the normal offline mode whose text says so; human form placed in the effectful shell as a rendering over the same derivation output and snapshot (no second computation on any form); criterion asserts the human form names the kind and renders its text. Revision: Status bullet + derivation entry + effectful shell + criterion.
